sentences.text: Eczematolepis was a member of the class Placodermi, an ancient group of armored fish, specifically within the family Ptyctodontidae.
The genus was first described by Miller in 1892, though it was originally named Acantholepis before that name was found to be already in use.
Fossils of this species have been found in the Milwaukee Formation of Wisconsin.
Eczematolepis lived during the Givetian stage, between 387.95 and 382.31 million years ago.
